title: Reliable Benchmarking of Artifact Detection in Computational Pathology: A Reproducibility and Uncertainty Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2608.30835v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Background and Objective: Quality control is a prerequisite for whole-slide image analysis, yet the benchmarks on which quality-control methods are compared share four properties that make their reported differences hard to interpret: few independent slides, annotation concentrated in a minority of them, pooled ratio metrics with no closed-form standard error, and a single inherited train/test partition. We propose a reliability protocol for such benchmarks. Methods: The protocol quantifies four sources of variability - test-set sampling, training stochasticity, partition composition, and undocumented preprocessing - a claim is reportable only if it survives all four; three of the four cost minutes of compute. We apply it to an independent reconstruction of a published diffusion-based artifact detector, evaluated on the original 24-slide partition and against a supervised baseline. translated_title: 计算病理学中伪影检测的可靠基准测试：可重复性与不确定性分析
translated_abstract: 背景与目标：质量控制是全切片图像分析的前提条件，然而用于比较质量控制方法的现有基准存在四个特性，使其报告的差异难以解释：独立切片数量少、标注集中在少数切片中、汇总比率指标缺乏闭式标准误、以及单一继承的训练/测试划分。我们为此类基准提出了一种可靠性协议。方法：该协议量化了四种变异来源——测试集抽样、训练随机性、划分组成以及未记录的预处理——只有经受住全部四项检验的结论才可报告；其中三项仅需几分钟的计算成本。我们将其应用于一个已发表的基于扩散模型的伪影检测器的独立复现，在原始的24张切片划分上进行评估，并与监督基线进行比较。结果：该方法的核心机制得到复现：（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种可靠性协议，通过量化测试集抽样、训练随机性、划分组成和未记录的预处理这四种变异来源，为计算病理学中伪影检测基准提供了可靠的可重复性与不确定性评估框架。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a reliability protocol that quantifies four sources of variability—test-set sampling, training stochasticity, partition composition, and undocumented preprocessing—to enable reliable and reproducible benchmarking of artifact detection in computational pathology.
